MLforSEO Academy · Introduction to Machine Learning for SEO

AI Blog-to-Social Post Transformer

Turn a blog post into three LinkedIn posts and five tweets, or a CSV of articles into one LinkedIn post and one tweet per row.

What you need
Your OpenAI API key
Cost
Paid per use on your own OpenAI account. Roughly 5 cents per article with chat-latest, or about $1 for a CSV of 50 full-length articles. With gpt-6-luna it is well under 1 cent per article.
Feed it
Pasted article text, or a CSV with a Content column (URL and Title columns are used when present)
You get back
Editable LinkedIn posts and tweets with character counts, plus generated-social-posts.csv with URL, Title, LinkedIn Post and Tweet columns

How to use it

  1. Paste your OpenAI API key and choose a model. The key stays in your browser and goes only to OpenAI.
  2. Paste one article, or switch to the CSV tab and upload a file with a Content column.
  3. Set the options: emojis, hashtags, audience, voice and an optional call to action.
  4. Generate, then edit any post in place and copy it.
  5. For a CSV, download the results file when the run finishes.

Worth knowing. The model is told to stay faithful to the article, but it can still overstate or invent a detail, so read every post against the source before you publish it.

2 · Your content

Paste one article for three LinkedIn posts and five tweets, or upload a CSV for one LinkedIn post and one tweet per row. Browsers cannot fetch other sites directly, so paste the text rather than a link.
Only the first 9,000 characters are sent to the model.
